curiosity.title: Scientists removed the glare from a James Webb telescope image — and unmasked a hidden planet

That's true even for the most sophisticated telescopes, including the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). Now, astronomers have developed a new way to spot planets that were formerly drowned out in a sea of light.
